name: Corrupted Soulfire Stoker

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. The Tender's corrupted stoker: 30 Hit Points and one Sear for each Multiattack.

traits.name: Corpse Fuel
traits.summary: Sees a corpse at its turn's start: it must go to it and spend its action burning it.
traits.text: When the stoker starts its turn able to see a corpse, it has to move as far as it can into the corpse's space and use its action to burn it. A Medium or smaller body becomes ash; a bigger one burns down by one size.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.summary: Slips through 1-inch gaps and into creatures' spaces; the first time it enters one on a turn, that creature takes 4 (1d8) Fire.
traits.text: The stoker passes through gaps an inch wide at no extra cost, can move into and stop in another creature's space, and the first time on a turn it enters a creature's space, that creature takes 4 (1d8) Fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The stoker gives off Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.

traits.name: Soul Burn
traits.summary: At the end of its turns, everything within 5 ft takes 4 (1d8) Necrotic.
traits.text: At the end of each of its turns, every other creature within 5 feet of the stoker takes 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sear
actions.summary: +5, 1d8+3 Fire, and the target attacks with Disadvantage until the stoker's next turn (the book: its next attack only).
actions.text: A lash of soul-fire: 7 (1d8 + 3) Fire damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the stoker's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Spectral Steam
bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 30-ft cone, DC 13 Dex save: for 1 minute the target glows (Dim Light 10 ft) and can't be Invisible.
bonus_actions.text: A gust of glowing ghost-steam. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, for 1 minute it sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and gains no benefit from being Invisible.

summary: A furnace spirit gone black with the curse that reached the fuel: weaker than the stoker the Express was built with, but it still can't leave a corpse unburned.
